name: Avinyó (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow Scandinavian cross patée, its fly arm pointed, the arms one sixth of the height at their narrowest.
history: The flag was approved on 23 December 1997 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2555 of 13 January 1998; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with a yellow Scandinavian cross patée pointed in the fly, its arms 1/6 of the height at their narrowest.

features.role: Scandinavian cross patée with the fly arm pointed
